# GitHub Copilot Instructions — Universal Design DNA

- For digital product design tasks, read and follow the project workflow and design rules in `CLAUDE.md`.
- Read `universal-design-intelligence/SKILL.md` and the relevant files in `universal-design-intelligence/references/` before design or implementation. Use `DESIGN.md` when the skill files are unavailable.
- Follow Discovery → Project DNA → Build → Verify → Report. Do not claim validations that were not run.
- Preserve existing APIs, data structures, authentication, routing, user flows, and business logic when modifying a project.
- Verify rendered UI in a browser when possible. Keep accessibility, truthful content, and asset attribution requirements.
